notes.title: Synstasis Soft Update v1.1
notes.notes:
Synstasis Demo has been given a update that exposes the "Invert Vertical Mouse Input" option in the Menus for users who desire Inverted Y look control Scheme. Be sure to Press "Apply" Button in the Lower Left Corner of Menu after making any changes.

Enjoy!
